title: 65_HS1-101634279_100-DE-18221_Serial_844
doc_notes: This document is an FBI office memorandum from 1958 regarding a civilian report of an unidentified flying object in Detroit.

incidents.summary: A Detroit resident reported seeing a circular object with a crystal-type dome reflecting lights moving in a northern direction.
incidents.quote: circular object with a crystal-type dome that reflected lights
